title: 🔥价格击穿长线平均持仓成本
body: 市场处于深度低估区。AHR999(3D)仅0.34，确认位于抄底区间。当前价格$63,852已大幅低于200日定投成本$73,159，偏离度-12.7%。这意味着长线筹码平均持仓已被击穿，下行空间极其有限，当前盈亏比极具优势。偏多。敢不敢做时间的朋友？
body_en: Market is in deep undervalued territory. AHR999 (3D) is just 0.34, confirming we're in the accumulation zone. Current price ($63,852) is significantly below the 200-day DCA cost ($73,159), a -12.7% deviation. This means long-term holder cost basis has been breached. Downside is extremely limited, and the risk-reward is highly favorable. Bullish. Do you have the guts to befriend time?
